headline: Fed-hike fears and an AI-spending wobble hit tech Friday; oil is swinging on Hormuz tensions and Iran-US talks, with Apple earnings tonight, midterms Tuesday and payrolls Friday.
rates: The 10-year yield is near 4.9-5.0% after the Fed held at 3.75-4.00% on Oct 28 with two dissents for a hike, and betting markets price a December hike as likely.
fed: No FOMC decision until Dec 8-9; Goolsbee speaks today and regional presidents have said a hike may still be needed, so Friday's payrolls is the key input.
oil: Oil is volatile near $100 (Brent reported higher, falling sharply Monday) on tanker attacks around the Strait of Hormuz and reports of Iran-US diplomacy.
geo: Middle East escalation risk around Hormuz plus US midterm elections on Tuesday Nov 3, where Democrats are expected to regain Congress.
